_purpose: This lesson has NO distinct dataset of its own -- it draws the project-standard >=500/class harmful-vs-benign set from steering_tutorials.common.data, which is exported ONCE at common/datasets/ and shared across every lesson that uses it. This file is a pointer, not a copy, so a 500/class slice is not duplicated into ten lessons' repos.
note: load_harmful_benign(n,seed) is a thin wrapper over build_harmful_benign(n,seed) returning just the prompt lists (rec['harmful'], rec['benign']); both APIs draw the identical underlying rows at matching (n_per_class, seed), so this lesson's data is byte-identical to the shared export.
